8202010.en: {relation|A|B}'s insights are well thought out. I couldn't agree more!
8202010.ch: {relation|A|B}的见解有理有据，我非常认同！

8202011.en: {relation|A|B}, has always persuaded with reason, and {relation|B|A} is convinced!

8202012.en: What you said today is true in every way! I cannot help but admire you, just a little.
8202012.ch: 你今日所言，面面俱到，句句在理！我都不禁对你生出一丝崇拜了。

8202013.en: {call|B|A} is right! But, what I'd like to say is, {call|B|A}'s casual smile is moving hearts.
8202013.ch: {call|B|A}所言极是！不过，我想说的是，{call|B|A}此刻不苟言笑的样子，真让人心动不已。

8202015.en: I do not agree with the idea! People on the Righteous paths are nothing but hypocrites!
8202015.ch: 我不认同阁下所言，正道之人不过是些道貌岸然的伪君子！

8202016.en: You are not a bad person, but some people of the Righteous Tao are pretentious and hypocritical!
8202016.ch: 虽说阁下倒是不俗之辈，但有些正道人士实在装腔作势，虚伪至极！

8202017.en: You are the same as those so-called people of the Righteous path. How hypocritical and disgusting!
8202017.ch: 你倒是和那些所谓的正道之人一派作风，真是惺惺作态，令人作呕！

8202018.en: I have always had misgivings about the Righteous path, but I'm so sorry I can't agree with your {relation|A|B}'s comments.
8202018.ch: 我向来对正道之人成见颇深，恕我无法认同{relation|A|B}你的言论。

8202020.en: I have always had misgivings about the Righteous path, but I'm so sorry I can't agree with {relation|A|B}'s comments.

8202037.en: I do not agree with the idea! The Demonic people are always full of cunning!
8202037.ch: 我不认同阁下所言，魔道之人尽是些狡猾善变的老狐狸！

8202038.en: You are not a bad person, but some Demonic people are just so unbearably arrogant!
8202038.ch: 虽说阁下倒是不俗之辈，但有些魔道人士实在妄自尊大，不知好歹！

8202039.en: You're like one of those Demonic people. You're arrogant and getting carried away!
8202039.ch: 你倒是和那些所谓的魔道之人一派作风，真是忘乎所以，狂妄至极！

8202101.ch: 我正道斩妖除魔，惩奸除恶！维护着八荒中的和平与秩序。前辈认为呢？

8202102.en: The demonic ones are passionate and courageous! The righteous ones are a bunch of do-good phoneys. What do you think, Mentor?
8202102.ch: 我魔道快意情仇，敢作敢当！正道人士不过是一群穷酸臭儒的伪君子。前辈认为呢？

8202103.ch: 前辈所言极是！正道之人的确值得敬佩。

8202104.en: You have a point, Mentor. Righteous people have always been generous and upstanding!
8202104.ch: 前辈言之有理。正道之人，向来宽惠正直！

8204510.en: {call|B|A}, I see that your Taoist Mind has shattered. I'd like to teach yous this <r>{taoistHeart|B}</r> path to help you re-center your Taoist Mind. Will you accept it?
8204510.ch: {call|B|A}，我观你此时道心破碎。今日欲将这<r>{taoistHeart|B}</r>之道传授于你，想助你重凝道心，你可愿接受？

8204511.en: Sect Leader, I've been thinking that since your Taoist Mind is shattered, I'd like to teach you this <r>{taoistHeart|B}</r> path to help you re-center your Taoist Mind. Will you accept it, Sect Leader?
8204511.ch: 宗主，在下想到您此时道心破碎，因此今日欲将这<r>{taoistHeart|B}</r>之道传授于你，想助你重凝道心，不知宗主您意下如何？

8204601.en: {call|B|A}, I hear that you have reached Breakthrough recently. Congratulations!
8204601.ch: {call|B|A},听闻你近日又突破了，可喜可贺。

8204603.en: Huh? You're reached {grade|A}! Your talent surpasses many. No wonder Master accepted you as disciple.
8204603.ch: 嗯？竟然到{grade|A}了！倒是天资过人，怪不得师父会收你为弟子。

8204605.en: {call|B|A}! I haven't seen you in days, and you've reached {grade|A}!

8204606.en: Mentor has reached {grade|A}! If you have some spare time, could you share some pointers?
8204606.ch: 前辈竟已到{grade|A}了！您若有闲暇，可否为在下指点一二？

8204607.en: {call|B|A}, it seems you've been doing well in cultivation lately.

8204608.en: Heaven rewards action. {call|B|A}, you worked so hard and got to {grade|A} today. You will be sure to reach {gradeV|1|A} soon!
8204608.ch: 天道酬勤，不进则退。{call|B|A}，你如此刻苦，今日能到{grade|A},想必不需多日就能{gradeV|1|A}了！

8204609.en: The juniors of {school|A} sure reach Breakthrough quickly. I am but a Rogue Cultivator, but I can give you some pointers on {grade|A} cultivation.
8204609.ch: {school|A}的小辈，突破还真是快。吾虽是散修，但在关于{grade|A}的修炼还是能给你些指点。

8204610.en: I am a Rogue Cultivator, but I know right from wrong. {call|B|A}, you have reached Breakthrough to {grade|A} recently, why do you continue staying in {school|A}? It is a trouble spot!
8204610.ch: 我虽是一介散修，却也明是非。{call|B|A}，你近日已突破到{grade|A},何苦继续留在{school|A}这是非之地！

8204611.en: I heard that you reached Breakthrough to {grade|A} a few days ago. Talent like yours is lacking in {school|B}!
8204611.ch: 听闻阁下前些日突破至{grade|A}，我{school|B}就缺您这种大能！

8204612.en: {call|B|A}, you've reached Breakthrough to {grade|A}, so why are you a Rogue Cultivator? Why not come to {school|B}? I'll take care of you!
8204612.ch: {call|B|A}，都突破至{grade|A}了，还做什么散修？不如来我{school|B}，我罩着你！

8204613.en: {call|B|A}, you have reached Breakthrough to {grade|A}, so why are you a Rogue Cultivator? My {relation|C|B} {name|C} is {post|C} at {school|C}. I'll ask {gender2|C} to put in a good word for you to join {school|C}. What do you say?
8204613.ch: {call|B|A}，都突破至{grade|A}了，还做什么散修？我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}是{school|C}的{post|C}，我让{gender|C}引荐你加入{school|C}如何？

8204614.en: You have reached Breakthrough to {grade|A}, so why are you a Rogue Cultivator? Why don't you come to {school|C}? I have many contacts here, and with my support, your way to the top is paved.
8204614.ch: 都突破至{grade|A}了，还做什么散修？不如来{school|C}吧！在这里我亲友众多。有我罩着，你可以横着走。

8204615.en: Mentor, you reached {grade|A}! Please treat me well in the future.
8204615.ch: 前辈您竟已到{grade|A}！日后可要多多关照我。

8204616.en: Huh? You're already {grade|A}? Good, good... As a fellow Rogue Cultivator, if there is any difference in your cultivation, you can come to me.
8204616.ch: 哦？你已经{grade|A}了，不错不错。同为散修，修行若是有何不通之处，可来寻我。

8204617.en: {call|B|A}, I heard that you've reached Breakthrough to {grade|A}! I am sincerely happy for you.
8204617.ch: {call|B|A}，听闻你突破至{grade|A}了，我真是由衷的替你感到开心。

8204618.en: My friend, you are now a powerful {grade|A} person. How does it feel?
8204618.ch: 吾友，你如今已经是{grade|A}的大能，滋味如何？

8204619.en: My friend, I'm sure that Breakthrough to {grade|A} requires many things to be done. I can help you if you tell me.
8204619.ch: 吾友，想必刚突破到{grade|A}应有许多需要做的事吧？若有告知，吾可助你。

8204620.en: {relation|A|B}, you are a {grade|A} power. How does it feel?
8204620.ch: {relation|A|B}，你如今已经是{grade|A}的大能，滋味如何？

8204621.en: {relation|A|B}, I am sure that Breakthrough to {grade|A} means there are many things to be done. Tell {relation|B|A}, and {relation|B|A} can help you!
8204621.ch: {relation|A|B}，想必刚突破到{grade|A}应有许多需要做的事吧？告诉{relation|B|A}，{relation|B|A}可助你！

8204622.en: Disciple, you are already {grade|A}. Indeed, the pupil surpasses the master.
8204622.ch: 徒儿你已{grade|A}了，还真是青出于蓝而更胜于蓝。

8204623.en: Disciple, you are already {grade|A}, but this is not enough. You must hurry and raise your cultivation to Master's level! Master can't protect you forever!
8204623.ch: 徒儿，你已{grade|A}了，但这还不够。你一定要尽快将修为提升到如师父这般！师父无法永远护着你啊！

8204624.en: Master, you have reached Breakthrough to {grade|A}. I am slow in progress, so I wonder when I will be as good as you.
8204624.ch: 师父你竟已突破到{grade|A}了，徒儿进境缓慢，不知几时才能如你一般厉害？

8204625.en: I heard that you have reached Breakthrough to {grade|A}, Master! I am so happy for you!
8204625.ch: 听闻师父你已突破到{grade|A}了，徒儿由衷地替您感到开心！

8204626.en: {call|B|A}, as expected of someone I admire. You reached Breakthrough to {grade|A} so quickly!
8204626.ch: {call|B|A}，不愧是我钟意之人，这么快都突破至{grade|A}了！

8204629.en: {relation|A|B}, I heard that you've reached Breakthrough to {grade|A}. Can you give me some pointers in cultivation?
8204629.ch: {relation|A|B}，听闻你突破至{grade|A}了，可否在修行中为我指点一二？

8204630.en: {relation|A|B}, I heard that you reached Breakthrough to {grade|A}. I came to congratulate you!
8204630.ch: {relation|A|B}，我听闻你突破至{grade|A}了，特此来祝贺你！

8204631.en: {call|B|A}, your cultivation was already far superior to mine, and you reached Breakthrough to {grade|A}!
8204631.ch: {call|B|A}，你的修为本已远超于我，如今又突破到{grade|A}，吾心甚慰！

8204632.en: {call|B|A}, you needs lots of things right after Breakthrough. If needed, tell {relation|B|A}, and they will find it for you!
8204632.ch: {call|B|A}，你刚突破想必需要很多东西。如有需要可告知{relation|B|A}，{relation|B|A}定为你寻来！

8205001.en: I heard that you had a Breakthrough to {grade|A} a few days ago. Why are you still staying in {school|A}? {school|A} is notorious and not a good place to stay for long!
8205001.ch: 听闻阁下前些时日突破至{grade|A},为何还留在{school|A}。{school|A}声名狼藉，不是久留之地呀！

8205002.en: I heard that you had a Breakthrough to {grade|A} a few days ago. A talented person chooses a patron of integrity. Why stay in {school|A}?
8205002.ch: 听闻阁下前些时日突破至{grade|A},为何还留在{school|A}。良禽择木而栖，你又何必继续留在{school|A}？

8205004.en: A talented person chooses a patron of integrity. {relation|A|B} has already had Breakthrough to {garde|A}, so why stay in {school|A}?

8205009.en: A talented person chooses a patron of integrity. You already had Breakthrough to {garde|A}, so why stay in {school|A}?

8206401.ch: 嗯…宗主您所言不虚，我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}的确风趣幽默，与{gender|C}相处甚是让人感到愉悦。

8206402.en: Well... You're right, Sect Leader. My {relation|C|B} does indeed have good character, and that is why {gender|C} and I are spouses.
8206402.ch: 嗯…宗主您所言不虚，我的{relation|C|B}的确品行俱佳，这也是我与{gender|C}结为夫妻的原因。

8206501.en: You are right, Sect Leader. {name|C}'s strength is beyond ordinary, and they are generous. I think you are both extremely competent Sect Leaders.
8206501.ch: 宗主您所言极是，{name|C}实力超凡，为人宽厚。在下认为，你们都是极为称职的宗主。

8206502.en: I have heard of your name in {school|B}, but I didn't expect you to be the Sect Leader of {school|A}. How admirable!
8206502.ch: 先前在{school|B}便听闻道友大名，想不到你竟然是{school|A}的宗主，真是令人钦佩。

10592419.en: Cultivators eradicate evil with their power and wander the world with ease. I really envy them.
10592419.ch: 修仙者除魔卫道、逍遥于天地之间，这些都让我十分羡慕。

10592420.en: I will cure my Nil Root Constitution no matter how difficult it will be.
10592420.ch: 若能摆脱体内的三阴绝脉体，再难再苦我也能忍受。

10592421.en: I wish I could learn from such an established cultivator like you.
10592421.ch: 真希望能多向你这样的修仙前辈好好请教一番。
